summary: Pass against w17 (8.5), with a small gain. The w18 high (the black cord) is fixed. In q14_seat26A the foreground seat's back/shell seam is now a continuous line from y 152 to the bottom of the frame. It is 1-3 px wide (4 px at most, 2.2 px on average) at L 41-70 over y 180-525, against w18's 7-8 px at L 4-22. That matches the py_37303 junction (a 2-3 px dip to L 60-65) at the right width and close to the right tone. The bead has no gaps, steps or proud chords at 2x zoom (raterPyA19/z_q14_fg.png). The mid seats in q14 and in p1, p7 and p8 show a hairline at the shell edge, which is the outline dark the integration rater asked for. In q13 the seam is fainter than in w18 and close to w17 (thin-dark 2.46 % against 2.42 %), so the mid-distance gain is small. The cubby mouths stay darker (p5, median L 19 -> 7). Keep them. The nose step was removed, and the cushion-front band is pixel-identical to w17 (p8 x 200 / 440, p5 x 150 / 500), so the w17 medium carries over. Only one new nit: the bead darkens to L 23-40 in the shaded bottom 50 px of q14 (y 540-575).
lighting_note: Not scored. With #3e434d the bead renders at L 41-70 in the lit part of q14 and at L 23-40 in the shaded lower corner. The photo's junction stays near L 60, so the corner shadow and AO still push the bead darker than the material alone would.
